claims.text: The reporting period included a total of 1,024 canonical cases.
Of these, 1,023 cases were classified as serious.

The most frequently reported reactions were Acute kidney injury (80 cases, 7.8%), Drug ineffective (54 cases, 5.3%), Hypotension (46 cases, 4.5%), Drug interaction (43 cases, 4.2%), and Dyspnoea (38 cases, 3.7%).
